title: EGujCopRecord
description: eGujCop (Gujarat Police CCTNS) table schema - stores First Information Reports, wanted criminal suspect records, and vehicle links

fir_number.description: Primary Key: First Information Report unique number (e.g. FIR-2026-AHM-CR-0089)

police_station.description: Jurisdictional police station where FIR was lodged

district.description: Gujarat police district or commissionerate (e.g. Ahmedabad City, Surat, Rajkot)

crime_head.description: Statutory IPC / BNS crime classification (e.g. Armed Robbery, Kidnapping, Vehicle Theft, Homicide)

accused_name.description: Name of accused suspect or person of interest

alias.description: Known alias, street name, or moniker of accused individual

wanted_status.description: Current apprehension status of the accused

linked_plate.description: Vehicle registration number linked to the accused or crime commission

missing_person_flag.description: True if this record corresponds to a missing person trace investigation

unidentified_body_flag.description: True if record pertains to an unidentified deceased inquiry

threat_priority.description: Tactical threat priority rating for automated intercept alerting
